build_boost_mysql_cmake: run cmake_build to configure, build, test, and install the Boost.MYSQL library with integration tests
build_boost_mysql_no_openssl: run cmake_noopenssl_build to verify Boost.MYSQL builds gracefully when OpenSSL is unavailable
build_boost_mysql_no_integration: run cmake_nointeg_build to build and test Boost.MYSQL with integration tests disabled
test_find_package_b2_distro: run find_package_b2_test to verify CMake can consume a Boost distribution created by b2
configure_cmake_runner: use _CMakeRunner to configure a CMake project with a generator, build type, and variables
